description: Create a new record in a form (insert row, add entry, new record). FIRST read the form's fields with describe_project or get_form_fields; the keys of 'data' are a field's id, its name or its html_name — any of the three those tools show; any other key is refused and nothing is written. One call makes ONE row: for several rows call it once per row (or seed_records). A value the person did not give is LEFT OUT — also for a field marked required: the row is made without it and the answer names it in left_empty; never ask for such values before making the rows and never invent them. The answer's 'linked' says which row each link of the new record points at, in that row's own words — read it: when it is not the row you meant, correct the link with update_record. IF the parent record is already known (the person says 'add a record to this child form from this record' / 'create a Registro for this Commessa') — pass the link to the parent AT ONCE through 'rels' in THIS call. Do NOT create an empty record and do NOT switch fields' visibility hoping the link fills itself in — it will not.

data.description: The record's fields: { key: value }. A key is the field's id (e.g. "a5tfWHm8jcW47cVcSbW6Sy"), its name or its html_name, as describe_project or get_form_fields show them.

rels.description: Rel-поля (зв'язки): { "field_id rel-поля": "ID запису до якого лінкувати" }. Ключ — ID rel-поля, значення — ID пов'язаного запису.

subforms.description: Subform-поля: { "field_id subform-поля": { "form_id": "ID субформи", "records": [{"field_id": "значення"}] } }. УВАГА: records має бути масивом ОБ'ЄКТІВ (hashes), а не масивом чисел чи ID!

values.description: Аліас для data — можна використовувати замість data (як в update_record)
